world.h: Zelenskyy holds Ukraine talks in Oslo with Witkoff
world.b: Zelenskyy is meeting US envoy Steve Witkoff and European officials in Oslo, with Jared Kushner joining remotely, as Trump publicly accuses him of not wanting to end the war.

world.h: Iran war: US says peace deal "extremely difficult"
world.b: Al Jazeera's live coverage: the US says a peace deal with Iran is extremely difficult amid attacks on ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
world.title: US says peace deal with Iran extremely difficult amid Hormuz ship attacks

national.h: Russia frees Michigan man Stephen Hubbard
national.b: Putin said he released Stephen Hubbard, 74, of Michigan, at President Trump's request. Hubbard was detained in eastern Ukraine in 2022 and sentenced to nearly seven years as a mercenary.
national.title: Russia releases imprisoned U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard following Trump's request

national.h: Report: fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests
national.b: Arrests for minor offenses rose from 2024 to 2025 even as violent crime fell to historic lows, according to an FWD.us analysis of federal data.
national.title: 2025 policing trend: Fewer serious crimes, more minor arrests

national.h: Ruidoso leaders chided flood warnings before deaths
national.b: ProPublica reports that leaders in Ruidoso, New Mexico, criticized residents who warned of flash floods before a 2025 flood killed two children and a man. Some first responders say the deaths were avoidable.
national.title: Town Leaders Chided Residents for Warning of Flash Floods. Then, the River Took Two Children.

national.h: Smuggler gets 30 years over deadly Texas truck
national.b: A federal judge sentenced Guatemalan Rigoberto Ramon Miranda-Orozco, 39, to 30 years in prison over a smuggling operation behind one of the deadliest such incidents on the US-Mexico border.

national.h: Florida carries out 18th execution of the year
national.b: Florida executed a 77-year-old man convicted of the 1986 shooting death of Indian River County sheriff's deputy Richard Raczkoski.
national.title: Florida puts 77-year-old man to death, carrying out its 18th execution of the year

national.h: TikTok staff raised child safety alarms, records show
national.b: Court depositions show TikTok employees repeatedly warned about risks to children, including sexual exploitation and suicide content, and were frustrated by leadership's response.

national.h: Supreme Court to hear school admissions race case
national.b: The court will consider parents' claims of discrimination over admissions to four Montgomery County, Maryland, magnet schools after lower courts dismissed the case.

politics.h: Some on DOJ "noncitizen" list appear US-born
politics.b: California and local officials told a court the Justice Department's list of 20,000 "likely" noncitizen voters looks unreliable, with some people on it recorded as born in the US.
"I'm not getting involved in Israeli elections," Vance said while campaigning for North Carolina Senate nominee Michael Whatley.

politics.h: California voters weigh billionaire wealth tax
politics.b: Prop 40 would impose a one-time 5% tax on about 250 billionaires holding an estimated $2.3 trillion. Supporters say it could raise up to $100 billion, mostly for healthcare.
politics.title: A Wealth Tax on Billionaires? California Voters to Decide Prop 40

politics.h: ProPublica: FBI purge ended Graham, Clyburn probe
politics.b: ProPublica reports Trump's FBI purge helped end a bribery investigation tied to defense contractor Navatek, which committed $40,000 in donations for a meeting with Lindsey Graham.
politics.title: How Trump’s FBI Purge Saved Lindsey Graham and James Clyburn From a Bribery Investigation

international.h: Witkoff meets Putin as Russia frees US citizen
international.b: US envoy Steve Witkoff began talks with Vladimir Putin in Saint Petersburg on ending the Ukraine war, after "positive" talks with Zelenskyy in Norway.
international.title: Witkoff in Russia for Putin meeting after ‘positive’ talks with Zelenskyy

international.h: Drone attack kills at least 153 in Abyei
international.b: A drone attack on Amiet Market in the disputed Abyei region between Sudan and South Sudan killed at least 153 people, an Abyei official said, blaming Sudan's military.
international.title: Drone attack in disputed Sudan-South Sudan border region kills at least 153

international.h: Houthis claim missile strike on Aden camp
international.b: A powerful explosion was heard in Aden. The Houthis said they hit the Saudi-led coalition's operations room at Badr Camp with a ballistic missile.
international.title: Blast heard in Yemen’s Aden as Houthis claim attack on military camp

international.h: French police accused of brutalising minors
international.b: Teenagers injured during France's protests describe police violence, including a 14-year-old whose jaw was smashed by a tear gas grenade and a 16-year-old blinded in one eye by a rubber bullet.
international.title: ‘I am still traumatised’: French police accused of brutalising minors

international.h: Gaza children go hungry as prices rise
international.b: Families in Gaza say they are struggling to feed their children after Israel restricted the entry of goods earlier this month, sending prices up as aid is cut.
international.title: Gaza children face worsening food shortages as prices rise and aid is cut

international.h: Zelenskyy: US missile warnings have resumed
international.b: Ukraine is again receiving early warnings of Russian ballistic missile attacks after talks with US officials including Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Zelenskyy said on a visit to Norway.
international.title: Zelenskyy says early warning system for Russian missile attacks resumes

international.h: Italy approves troops, tougher protest penalties
international.b: The Italian cabinet approved sending 500 troops to Milan, a new offence for violent participation in demonstrations, tougher penalties for rioters and financial liability for parents of children who join looting.

international.h: Portugal protesters return to cleared camps
international.b: Cost-of-living protesters in Lisbon and Porto moved back into sit-in camps police had cleared, arresting 55 people. They want the government to withdraw a bill easing evictions and ending rent caps on new leases.

international.h: UN experts urge India to stop excessive force
international.b: Independent UN experts called for an impartial investigation into Indian authorities' handling of protests, saying demonstrators were injured and some reported ill-treatment.

international.h: King Charles hosts Oman's sultan on state visit
international.b: Sultan Haitham bin Tariq was welcomed at Windsor Castle and said Oman has chosen diplomacy in a region rife with conflict, as the King praised its peace efforts.

international.h: NATO sends more patrol planes to Black Sea
international.b: Allies are sending maritime patrol aircraft, radar, drones and intelligence staff to the Black Sea after drone attacks, NATO said.
A woman admitted to a private hospital in Abuja tested positive, and health officials are tracing 44 contacts amid fears of wider spread in Africa.

international.h: Over 250,000 displaced in Yemen as fighting grows
international.b: UNHCR said more than 250,000 people have been displaced since fighting escalated, with Taiz accounting for 76 percent of departures.

international.h: UK to send Typhoon jets to defend Saudi Arabia
international.b: Britain will fly defensive counter-air missions with RAF Typhoons to protect Saudi cities and infrastructure from Houthi attacks, but will not strike the group.
About 76% of Alberta voters backed staying in Canada in a referendum that could have started a path to separation, a win for PM Mark Carney.

international.h: Four dead as Storm Adam floods eastern Spain
international.b: Storm Adam dumped up to 700 litres of rain per square metre in 24 hours in parts of Valencia, isolating towns and prompting shelter orders for tens of thousands.

international.h: Australian MP Helen Haines loses both legs
international.b: Doctors amputated both of MP Helen Haines' legs after a driver hit her twice with his car in Wangaratta on Monday. Her husband said she is alive and stable as the suspect appeared in court.
international.title: Australian MP loses both legs in vehicle attack as suspect appears in court

business.b: The Wall Street Journal reported Anthropic lost $80bn in the first half of 2026, mostly from $72bn in accounting charges tied to convertible notes, ahead of an expected IPO.
business.title: Anthropic posts $80bn loss in first half of 2026: WSJ

business.b: The largest version of Boeing's bestselling 737 family is cleared for passenger service after thousands of hours of test flights, Transportation Secretary Duffy said.
business.title: FAA approves Boeing's 737 Max 10 for passenger service

business.h: Magic: The Gathering drives Hasbro growth
business.b: Hasbro said third-quarter revenue rose 15% from a year earlier, led by its Magic: The Gathering card game.
business.title: Magic: The Gathering is driving growth at Hasbro

business.h: AI now among Americans’ top 10 fears
business.b: Chapman University's survey of fears found AI harming the political process ranked No. 3 and AI hurting the economy No. 7, the first time AI made the top 10.

business.h: Saudi Arabia cancels 'Davos in the Desert'
business.b: The Future Investment Initiative, set for Oct. 26-29, was called off amid deadly Houthi strikes on the kingdom, with a new date to be announced.

science.h: UN report: US climate pollution rose sharply
science.b: A UN report finds the US was the only major economy whose planet-warming emissions rose dramatically last year, tying Russia for the highest per-capita emissions in the G20. Global emissions were roughly flat.
science.title: United Nations report highlights significant increase in U.S. climate pollution

sports.h: LeBron's 76ers debut spoils Knicks' ring night
sports.b: The 76ers beat the Knicks 106-100 at Madison Square Garden on the defending champions' banner night. LeBron James had 14 points, nine rebounds and seven assists.

sports.h: Ohio State QB Julian Sayin out indefinitely
sports.b: Coach Ryan Day said Sayin may miss the rest of the season, a blow to the No. 3 Buckeyes' title hopes. Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair will share first-team snaps.

sports.h: Commanders' Terry McLaurin out for season
sports.b: The wide receiver hurt his knee in the first quarter of Monday night's loss to the 49ers, and tests on Tuesday confirmed a season-ending injury.

sports.h: Titans release DT Jordan Elliott after 'incident'
sports.b: Tennessee released defensive tackle Jordan Elliott after reviewing an Oct. 15 incident at the team facility and said it would not comment further.

sports.h: Rays beat Guardians, will face Brewers in World Series
sports.b: Yandy Díaz and Junior Caminero each hit two-run homers as Tampa Bay won ALCS Game 6 7-3. The Series will produce a first-time champion.

sports.h: Reese scores 30 as Dream even WNBA Finals
sports.b: Angel Reese had 30 points and 16 rebounds as Atlanta beat Golden State 79-65 in Game 2, tying the series 1-1.

local.h: Schools chancellor offers no integration plan
local.b: Chancellor Kamar Samuels said the Mamdani administration is committed to integrating NYC public schools but declined to share a specific plan, drawing groans from a frustrated crowd.
local.title: Parents grumble as NYC schools chancellor dodges calls for NYC schools integration plan

local.h: Driver found shot after George Washington Bridge crash
local.b: Port Authority police found a driver with an apparent gunshot wound to the head after a single-vehicle crash on the bridge Tuesday night.
local.title: Driver found with apparent gunshot wound on George Washington Bridge, officials say

local.h: NYC proposes rules for AI customer service bots
local.b: A proposed rule would require businesses to disclose AI chatbots and let customers talk to a person instead. The city says it is the first of its kind.
local.title: NYC proposes crackdown down on AI customer service chatbots

periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 48. Breezy, with a north wind 9 to 14 mph increasing to 15 to 20 mph after midnight.

periods.name: Friday
periods.text: Sunny, with a high near 57. North wind 10 to 14 mph.

periods.name: Friday Night
periods.text: Mostly clear, with a low around 45.

localgood.h: Coney Island's 1890s lighthouse may be landmarked
localgood.b: The Landmarks Preservation Commission voted to hold a hearing on the 70-foot lighthouse, which has guided boats for more than 135 years, and its keeper's house.
localgood.title: Coney Island's small, 1890s lighthouse may be landmarked by the city
